_readme: Vapor catalogue. launch.type: 'iframe' (game runs in an LTF OS window; url may be relative to static/ or absolute), 'isolated' (rendered through /proxy/page in a cookie-less sandbox) or 'external' (opens a new browser tab). Sites that forbid embedding show an error screen with 'Open in browser tab'. cover = 16:9 art, capsule = 3:4 art (optional).

items.title: Blocks
items.description: A falling-block puzzle game with ghost pieces, wall kicks, hard drop and progressive speed.
items.controls: Arrow keys to move and rotate, Space to hard drop, P to pause.

items.title: Snake
items.description: The classic: steer, grow and avoid your own tail. Speed increases as you eat.
items.controls: Arrow keys or WASD to steer, P to pause.

items.title: Pong
items.description: Table tennis against a computer opponent. First to seven points wins.
items.controls: W/S or Up/Down to move your paddle, P to pause.
